description: Approved dependency license policy for Notify-Chain. All runtime dependencies across Node.js packages (dashboard, listener, frontend) and the Rust contract must carry at least one license from the 'allowed' list. Deviations require explicit sign-off and must be recorded in 'exceptions'.

nodejs.notes: Run from each package directory after npm ci. The --production flag restricts checks to runtime dependencies only; devDependencies are excluded.

rust.notes: Run from the contract/ workspace root. exclude-dev = true in deny.toml mirrors the --production behaviour of the Node checker.

reviewProcess: Open a GitHub issue tagged 'license-review' and get approval from a maintainer before adding a dependency whose license is not in the allowed list. Record the approved exception in the 'exceptions' array above with fields: package, license, reason, approvedBy, approvedDate.
